title: Story premise EDU025: The Double-Counted Visitor
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: Is this a new visitor, or the same badge again? Takeaway/theme: Deduplication depends on a clearly defined identity and counting rule.
description: A curator wants a visitor total from two entrance logs, but counts a returning badge twice. Matching a defined visit identifier and showing the excluded duplicate produces a transparent total.
